input_policy.legacy: pre_independence historical only; preserved and excluded from clean candidate input/frontier guidance

inheritance.semantics: All revision-3 canonical families/scopes/provenance remain inherited unless explicitly extended below; this revision does not reset prior clean_g1 state.

evidence_strength.status: layered current evidence; every feed item has candidate-level evidence provenance

decision_relevance.status: base plus incremental new/materially-updated clean candidates; every feed item has candidate-level relevance provenance

canonicalization.identity: semantic mechanism + clean source artifact/version; raw IDs alone are not trusted across checkpoints
canonicalization.scientist_agent_collision_guard: clean scientist-agent artifacts reused IDs 003 and 005-008 for different mechanisms; preserve source-bound candidate instances and sci-1801-* comparator identities; never merge by raw ID alone

delta_families.boundary: Offline verifier quality, search-selection reliability, and target-distribution transfer are separate failure modes; no blanket rejection of verifier-guided methods.
Large OCBA speedups are setting-specific; finite-budget fallback/racing remains necessary.
Matched fault robustness and observational environment-barrier attribution are distinct; neither gives a universal production failure rate.
Run variance/policy integrity and benchmark contamination are separate axes; best-run performance is insufficient evidence.
Diagnostic benchmarks establish active-state failure modes but do not by themselves prove one remediation architecture.
Environment/context rewind and dependency-local invalidation have different reversibility assumptions and must remain separately scoped.

feed_selection.policy: compact high-information-density subset only: formal novelty uncovered/partial under-evaluation, high decision relevance, traceable current evidence, exact scope retained

contradiction_register.pattern: more/better verifier signal can worsen optimized behavior
more memory/context exposure can underperform selective/no-op admission
multi-agent topology effect can reverse sign by task structure

blockers.detail: Revision 4 intentionally inherits the complete revision-3 materialized family index by immutable blob/digest and records only current deltas; no prior clean state was reset or silently reconstructed.

exact_continuation: Re-scan only clean worker/comparator namespaces. Diff semantic candidate instances and comparator artifact SHAs; extend the delta chain or safely materialize it without losing revision-3 provenance. Re-evaluate feed admission only for new/changed candidates. Never write comparator/integrator/O information into clean workers.
digest_basis: SHA-256 canonical JSON excluding content_digest_sha256,digest_basis (sort_keys=true,compact separators,UTF-8).
